headword: シンガーソングライター
reading: しんがーそんぐらいたー
gloss: singer-songwriter (a musician who writes and performs their own songs)

definitions.gloss: singer-songwriter; a musician who writes and performs their own songs
definitions.explanation: A musician who both composes and performs their own songs — typically writing their own lyrics and music and singing them themselves. The term entered Japanese music journalism in the 1970s with the rise of folk and adult-contemporary singer-songwriters and is now standard vocabulary for anyone whose performances feature their own original material.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧なシンガーソングライター。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧シンガーソングライターだ。
examples.english: She is a singer-songwriter who writes her own songs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧シンガーソングライター⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}めている→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧。
examples.english: A young singer-songwriter is drawing major attention.

examples.japanese: ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧ハウス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{自作|じさく}→自作：13968_jisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}いて→磨く：02427_migaku⟧きたシンガーソングライター⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、ついに⟦メジャー→メジャー：11595_mejaa⟧⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: A singer-songwriter who has been polishing her original songs while continuing to play at live music venues has finally made her major-label debut.

notes:
シンガーソングライター is the English compound "singer-songwriter" naturalized into Japanese. It is the standard term in Japanese music writing for an artist who writes and performs their own songs.

IMPLIED MEANING:
- The artist writes both lyrics (⟦{作詞|さくし}→作詞：05233_sakushi⟧) and music (⟦{作曲|さっきょく}→作曲：02824_sakkyoku⟧)
- The artist also performs the songs themselves
- Often associated with acoustic, folk, J-pop, and adult-contemporary genres, but used across all genres including rock, hip-hop, and electronic

FORMS:
- Frequently abbreviated as SSW in Japanese music journalism (e.g., "⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧SSW" = "young singer-songwriters")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧シンガーソングライター: female singer-songwriter
- ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧シンガーソングライター: young/up-and-coming singer-songwriter
- ⟦ベテラン→ベテラン：11121_beteran⟧シンガーソングライター: veteran singer-songwriter
- シンガーソングライター⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}する→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧: to be active as a singer-songwriter
- シンガーソングライター⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧: to aim to become a singer-songwriter
- ⟦{弾|ひ}き{語|がた}り→弾き語り：28503_hikigatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧シンガーソングライター: a singer-songwriter who accompanies herself on guitar/piano

SIMILAR / RELATED TERMS:
- ⟦{作詞|さくし}{家|か}→作詞家：21752_sakushika⟧: lyricist — someone who writes lyrics (often for other performers)
- ⟦{作曲|さっきょく}→作曲：02824_sakkyoku⟧⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧: composer — someone who writes music
- ⟦{歌手|かしゅ}→歌手：00197_kashu⟧: singer (general) — does not imply songwriting
- ⟦アーティスト→アーティスト：10712_aatisuto⟧: artist (loanword) — the broader, more flexible term covering all sorts of musicians and performers
- ミュージシャン: musician (loanword) — emphasizes instrumental skill; partly overlaps with ⟦アーティスト→アーティスト：10712_aatisuto⟧
- ⟦{弾|ひ}き{語|がた}り→弾き語り：28503_hikigatari⟧: self-accompanied performance — describes the performance style often associated with singer-songwriters but is a separate concept

USAGE:
- A pop idol who sings songs written by professional songwriting teams is not typically called a シンガーソングライター — the term implies meaningful authorship of one's material.
- The katakana spelling is invariant; you will not see this written in kanji. Pronunciation reflects the English origin: しんがー・そんぐ・らいたー.
